status: Proposed for discussion; not approved or implemented
direction: Standard Roblox BrickColors, cyan header with red close control, studded purple structure and smooth grey ball surfaces

roles.header: Cyan title bar and active category tab
roles.card: Smooth neutral ball tiles and selected-ball detail panel
roles.close: Bright red reserved for close/error controls, not broad branding surfaces
roles.text: White outlined display text; Black body text on Light stone grey copy panels

display.style: Normal; genuine heavy display face, no synthetic bold, no wide tracking or italics
display.outline: 2px dark outside stroke on large text; 1.5px on card labels; crisp 2px downward shadow

interface.outline: No outline on small copy; place it on a solid recessed surface

fontVerification.method: Read installed Roblox content/fonts/families JSON, inspected font name tables and embedded those exact local TrueType files; no external font dependency in preview

treatments: Keep the accepted raised square stud treatment on structural backplates and title bars
Remove all studs from ball cards, selected-ball detail panel, category buttons and Equip button
Smooth Medium stone grey separates ball artwork from purple structure
Crisp 2–3px outlines, narrow highlights and lower bevels remain
Native Fredoka One and Source Sans Pro Semibold font files retained
scope: Visual direction proposal only; no runtime source edits, new gameplay or benchmark implementation
gameplay: Keep existing cyan/coral team identities and territory meaning; do not recolor gameplay by cosmetic palette.
pending: User approval of revised palette and smooth/studded surface roles
Complete Inventory and Store mockups, including all appearances and phone layouts
Frozen benchmark target and acceptance scope
preview: Local category switching, six canonical ball appearances, select/equip, close/reopen, and fixed BrickColor choices for header and card shade. Design preview only; no runtime edits or completed benchmark.
browserQA: Static markup, source, selector and JavaScript syntax checks only; exact fonts embedded. No rendered browser QA claimed.
contrastMethod: Calculated solid sRGB foreground/background pairs only. Gradients, raised highlights and outlines also affect rendered appearance; native Studio and phone visual approval remains pending.

brickColorReference.note: Base colors are exact BrickColor RGB values; bevel lighting and shadow tints are derived.

navigation.userConfirmed: Category tab inside Inventory; follow the in-game structure
navigation.balls: Selecting a ball updates the adjacent detail panel and Equip action; stack detail under the grid on narrow screens
navigation.otherCategories: Use existing canonical icons and source copy for cosmetic previews and Fusion availability; no purchase, unlock or gameplay behavior added
